verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Every term of (4.11) is present, but 𝒯₀ is not defined by this formula in Lean: `stressVector` is defined as the pair (LeadingStress.theta, LeadingStress.axial) built from the residual algebra, and (4.11) appears as the proved equality `stressVector_eq_stocks`, with hypotheses p ∈ D.carrier, 0 < X and P.f p ≠ 0 (the paper writes the identity without these side conditions). Term by term: P.f = F; profileStockOne = X·Q_s/L and profileStockTwo = X·N_s/(L·E) are p_s; angularShear = 1 - 2X·E_X/E = 1 - 2𝒟_X log E = a and signedAxialShear = -2X·U_X/E = -b_s give 𝔰 = (a, -b_s); the scalar multiple is F. The paper's third expression a = 2 - 2l (l = 1 + X F_X/F) is not stated in this form; the equal expression -2 X f_X / f is `ActivationContinuation.shearA`, tied to `angularShear` by `modulated_shears_eq`, and one still has to use E = √(2X) f to pass between 1 - 2𝒟_X log E and -2 X f_X / f.
